cd "C:/Users/shrey/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/C--Users-shrey-Desktop-Elemental-harness/48fd0b89-0bb7-4d72-841b-60770e4d02b7/scratchpad"; powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { \$_.CommandLine -match 'run-eval|dsh-eval-' } | Select-Object ProcessId,Name | Format-Table -HideTableHeaders"; git -C upstream worktree list
echo ---scan for git peeking in all runs---
PYTHONIOENCODING=utf8 python - <<'EOF'
import json,glob,re
pat=re.compile(r'git\s+(diff|show|log|restore|checkout|stash|reset|status)')
for f in sorted(glob.glob('gem-*/*.events.jsonl')):
    hits=[]
    for l in open(f,encoding='utf8'):
        e=json.loads(l)
        if e.get('type')!='tool/call': continue
        d=e.get('data',{}); a=d.get('arguments'); s=a if isinstance(a,str) else json.dumps(a)
        m=pat.findall(s)
        if m: hits.append(re.search(r'git[^"\\]{0,80}',s).group(0))
    print(f, len(hits), hits[:6])
EOF
input.description: Check for leftover processes and scan all runs for git peeking
